question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

 One who speaks less
solution:
The correct answer is: **Taciturn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Taciturn"** refers to a person who is reserved or speaks very little. Such individuals are often quiet and prefer not to engage in excessive conversation. (कम बोलने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** He was known for being taciturn, rarely speaking unless absolutely necessary.
 
 
• **"Taciturn"** is the perfect one-word substitution for someone who speaks less. (कम बोलने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his taciturn nature, his actions spoke louder than words.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the correct answer is **Taciturn**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Taciturn**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Orator** (वक्ता): Someone who is skilled in public speaking or giving speeches.
 
 
• **Example:** The orator captivated the audience with his powerful speech.
 
 
 
• **Recluse** (एकांतवासी): A person who lives in isolation and avoids social interactions.
 
 
• **Example:** After the tragic loss, he became a recluse and rarely stepped out of his house.
 
 
 
• **Introvert** (अंतर्मुखी): A person who tends to focus more on their inner thoughts and feelings rather than seeking external stimulation from social interactions.
 
 
• **Example:** She is an introvert who enjoys spending time alone reading books.
